--- settings file ---
# Written by SGC. Do not edit: SGC replaces this file.
# Removing it puts the SSH server back to this machine's own settings.

# Keys added in SGC's page are kept in a file of SGC's own, in addition to
# the ones each account keeps in its home folder. %u is the account's name.
AuthorizedKeysFile .ssh/authorized_keys .ssh/authorized_keys2 /etc/sgc/ssh/keys/%u

# Keys only: no passwords, and nobody logs in as root.
PubkeyAuthentication yes
PasswordAuthentication no
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
PermitRootLogin no
